verdict.rationale: AMD's MI355X product page publishes capacity (288GB), memory type (HBM3E) and bandwidth (8TB/s) for this exact part, and Chips and Cheese independently cites the same 288 GB HBM3E at 8 TB/s. Nothing in the pack gives the memory bus width, so the 'published in full' bar is not met. missing for 10: memory bus width (and stack/interface configuration), detailed first-party spec-sheet documentation beyond the marketing headline.
